statement: A single-file, phone-first website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune. Visitors can browse products by category, filter by size and price, read the size guide, see new arrivals, order on WhatsApp, view a lookbook, and find store hours, location, policies and reviews.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy and elegant look: warm natural colours and a refined type style.
Works well on phones first, and also on desktop.
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step.
Use only facts the Requester supplied. No invented products, prices, numbers, offers or claims.
rules: Sarees and dupattas are free size.
Exchange only, within 7 days, if unworn with tags. No returns on sale items.
Delivery: Pune in 2 days, Rs 79, free above Rs 2,999, pay on delivery.
done_when: The file shows the name Thread & Loom, Pune, with an earthy, elegant colour scheme.

The file lists all 10 products under four categories, with these exact names and prices: Kurtas: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199. Sarees: Ikat handloom saree 3,499; Khadi silk saree 4,999; Cotton jamdani saree 3,999. Shirts: Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599. Dupattas: Block-print dupatta 899; Chanderi dupatta 1,099.

The file has working category browsing and working size and price filters. Sizes: Indigo block-print kurta S-XXL; Mustard handloom kurta S-XL; White chikankari kurta XS-XL; Khadi cotton shirt S-XXL; Linen-blend shirt M-XXL; all sarees and dupattas free size.
The file has a size guide table with chest in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42.
Every product has an order button linking to WhatsApp number 910000011111 with the product name in the message.
The file shows the address 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005, shop phone +91 00000 22222, and timings 11am to 9pm Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday.
The file shows the return and exchange policy: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags, no returns on sale items.
The file shows the delivery details: Pune in 2 days, Rs 79, free above Rs 2,999, pay on delivery.
The file has a mobile viewport tag, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, no JavaScript errors, and no broken in-page links.
